chapters.title: Global Mandate Timeline and Voluntary Usage

features.name: New E-Document Connectors
features.description: Addition of new default endpoints including Avalara, B2B Router, Contineo, Logic Sign, Every, and Commerce in collaboration with partners. Eight default connectors total by end of wave.
caveats: Connectors developed with partners in open source collaboration model
Commercial terms require separate contracts with providers
Code review process may delay immediate availability

features.name: Attachments as Encoded Objects in XML
features.description: Feature to include encoded attachments within XML files to improve human readability of electronic documents beyond machine-readable format.

features.name: Improved Search in E-Documents
features.description: Enhancement to search functionality in e-documents module to make it easier to find documents without requiring special characters like dashes.

features.name: E-Documents Framework Stabilization
features.description: Focus on stabilizing the e-documents framework through work on small internal features to ensure reliability and robustness of the platform.

features.name: E-Documents APIs
features.description: APIs for e-documents to enable reuse in purchasing and sales processes. Postponed from major release to allow for API improvements.
caveats: Timeline is approximate - delivery expected at version 25.3

features.name: Peppol Format with Data Exchange Definition
features.description: Peppol B3 format available by default in W1 with both code and data exchange definition provided as a showcase for building custom formats.

features.name: UBL/XML Format for Germany
features.description: UBL/XML format localization for Germany to ensure compliance with mandatory electronic invoicing requirements effective January 2025.

features.name: Fattura PA Format for Spain
features.description: Fattura PA format localization for Spain to meet compliance requirements for mandatory electronic invoicing starting January 2025.
caveats: Will be mandatory usage in Spain from 2025

features.name: Peppol Format for Australia and New Zealand
features.description: Peppol format localization for Australia and New Zealand for recommended B2B electronic invoicing usage.
features.status_evidence_quote: P and Z format for Australia New Zealand will come after new year

features.name: Avalara Integration
features.description: New integration with Avalara for sending and receiving electronic invoices with setup requiring client ID, client secret, and company ID mapping.

features.name: Document Sending Profile for Customers
features.description: Feature to set document sending profiles on customer master data to enable automatic routing through e-documents framework when posting sales invoices.

features.name: Automatic Scheduled Import for Receiving Documents
features.description: Feature to configure automatic scheduled imports to periodically check for and receive incoming electronic documents from vendors without manual intervention.
